title: As Trump Goes to China, A.I. Tensions Surge Amid Spying and Safety Fears
summary_full: The espionage concerns that led to Jensen Huang’s ouster at Nvidia highlight a core challenge to diplomacy between Washington and Beijing on A.I. advancement.
